title: macroptilium bracteatum
intro: Macroptilium bracteatum, commonly known as the sensitive plant or sensitive pea, is a perennial legume native to Mexico and Central America. This plant is known for its compound leaves and unique ability to fold up its leaves when touched or disturbed. Macroptilium bracteatum has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory effects, and antimicrobial properties.
